round19_plan.roles: root integration with delegated advisor-skeptic function, plus forward derivation and independent reverse/skeptic reconstruction roles as assigned; count advisory reviews separately from scientific research loops
advisor_decisions: post-Goal-A review after A1 and A2
round19_plan.sequential_gate_rule: only A1 is frozen now; A2 is selected after A1 evidence; B/C remain provisional until the post-Goal-A advisor decision; repeated execution of one implementation is not independent reconstruction

goal: Goal A boundary-consistent local clusters and dense stability bridge
a1_question: Can the strip-family boundary rule be replaced by literal restrictions of one fixed infinite coefficient assignment while preserving a uniform local full-link lower bound for every clipped component that appears in finite boxes?

physical_contract.hilbert_space: untruncated L2 product Haar link space on finite open cubic subgraphs, with all-vertex Gauss law imposed only after the full-link ground/gap argument
physical_contract.hamiltonian: H_N = alpha * sum_e C_e - sum_f lambda_f x_f, C_e=j(j+1), x_f=Tr(U_f)/2
physical_contract.units: alpha, lambda_f, mu and E_star are physical energy coefficients; C_e and x_f are dimensionless; any physical family conclusion requires fixed local coefficients on overlaps and alpha/E_star bounded below by a declared positive value, equivalently alpha >= alpha_min > 0 when E_star is fixed
physical_contract.state: finite-volume ground and first excitation of the full-link operator; no continuum or thermodynamic state is assumed
physical_contract.boundary: finite boxes inherit all terms whose faces are present from one declared infinite local coefficient assignment; faces may be clipped into one-, two-, or three-face components
physical_contract.regulator: finite open cubic graph only; no representation truncation, no continuum limit, no Euclidean kappa/time-generator matching
physical_contract.observable: proved lower bound on the full-link gap and the induced Gauss-sector physical gap for the declared boundary-consistent local family
physical_contract.energy_reference: Freeze one symbolic E_star > 0 for Round19 A1 spectral comparisons. Record alpha/E_star separately from every lambda/alpha or mu/alpha ratio, finite volume N and any lattice-spacing label. Reject E_star=0 normalization.
physical_contract.not_physical_energies: static Euclidean kappa, Fibonacci/golden-ratio node labels, graph coordinates and presentation geometry do not define Hamiltonian energies, physical time or volume scaling without a separate matching equation and test

fixed_candidate_assignment.selected_faces: xy faces on even y rows with x phase 0,1,2 mod 4 carry left, bridge, right coefficients respectively; all other faces are omitted for A1 unless explicitly classified as a separate remainder in A2
fixed_candidate_assignment.coefficient_bounds: |lambda_left|, |lambda_right| <= alpha/2 and |mu_bridge| <= alpha/8, with signs and zeros allowed
component_types_to_prove: two contiguous selected faces: left+bridge and bridge+right
fixed_candidate_assignment.common_local_target: each component must have a full-link gap lower estimate at least alpha/8 under the same alpha and fixed local coefficients
fixed_candidate_assignment.scale_register: A1 must output E_star, alpha/E_star, lambda_left/alpha, lambda_right/alpha, mu_bridge/alpha, finite graph extent/phase, and any lattice-spacing label as separate fields; kappa is absent from the A1 Hamiltonian contract.

tasks: derive the finite component bounds for every clipped component from the actual signed graph and full-link domains
prove the zero reference expectations from an actual free Haar link or use the generic two-norm fallback
enumerate finite boxes and phase offsets to show every inherited selected component is classified
produce exact fixtures and source manifest

do not identify Euclidean kappa with lambda/alpha

tasks: start from the desired nested-restriction conclusion and independently reconstruct the necessary coefficient consistency, component classification and gap inequalities
construct rejecting fixtures for n-dependent reclassification, missing clipped types, missing free-link zero mean and common-scale withdrawal
compare producer evidence without importing producer classification code
forbidden: do not certify by matching producer JSON alone
do not convert an insufficient lower estimate into a zero residual pass

acceptance_tests: A positive E_star is declared once; alpha/E_star is recorded independently of coupling ratios and finite volume. Any E_star=0 or tolerance-based normalization is rejected.
The infinite coefficient assignment is declared once and every finite coefficient is the literal restriction of it; a face present in two boxes has the same coefficient in both.
All one-face, two-face and three-face clipped components reachable by finite-box phase/side choices are classified with exact signed links and domains.
For each component type, the proof supplies a full-link gap lower estimate >= alpha/8 or explicitly blocks that type; Gauss-sector restriction is justified only after full-link uniqueness/invariance.
At least one exact finite enumeration covers n=2..12 and all four x-phase offsets, with a separate analytic argument for all n.
Independent verification uses different representation or graph construction and passes withheld boundary phases.
Normal and optimized executions produce identical semantic results and all accepted files are source-hash bound.
falsifying_controls: Set E_star=0 or replace E_star by a static Euclidean kappa/tolerance/Fibonacci index; the spectral comparison must reject the run before any gap claim.
Round18-style complete-strip-only selection where f2:4,0,0 changes coefficient between n=6 and n=8 must be rejected as non-restriction.
Omit a one-face or two-face clipped component and require the verifier to find a reachable finite-box phase that is unclassified.
Remove the actual free-link Haar premise and require the sharper one-norm lower bound to block or fall back to the generic bound.
Withdraw alpha_min > 0 or let alpha vary without local coefficient convergence; any physical common-scale conclusion must block.
Alter one signed face word or use an outer-boundary-only graph; exact graph validation must fail.
Try to promote this local component result to a homogeneous dense, thermodynamic, continuum, or mass-gap theorem; route must remain open/blocked.
stop_condition: Stop A1 after the smallest all-component classification and independent verifier comparison either prove the alpha/8 local bound for literal restrictions or identify a concrete component/premise where it fails. Do not expand to A2 compactness/spectral-passage work inside A1.
known_not_proved: existence of a thermodynamic limiting dynamics/state
volume-uniform dense nondecaying homogeneous rotor stability
continuum Yang-Mills construction or Clay mass gap
physical role of the double-Fibonacci/common-scale analogy
physical significance of paired or double-Fibonacci expansion geometry without a declared held-out observable and comparison model
